mentions.name: Karaoke Pitch
mentions.description: A free, open-source browser extension that lets users adjust the pitch of a YouTube video and optionally store the chosen pitch for later. The author uses it as a way to practice singing and music. It is available for Firefox and Chrome; the Firefox version has about 40 average daily users and the Chrome version has 287 installs.
